summary: Validated SPA rewrite fix for Vercel deploy and full regression on Horvath multi-view SPA. Confirmed vercel.json rewrite config (/(.*) -> /index.html) exists in both /app/frontend/vercel.json and /app/vercel.json. On preview base URL, all 5 routes render correctly on direct/fresh navigation with the expected data-testid heroes and no console/page errors. Backend API tests (5/5) pass. All regression flows (nav + active link, ES/EN toggle + persistence, back-to-top, contact form success, logo three-tier in header/footer) work.
critical_code_review_comments: SPA rewrite correctly configured in both /app/frontend/vercel.json and root /app/vercel.json. Since outputDirectory=frontend/build is set at the root vercel.json (monorepo build), the root file's rewrites govern the deployment; the frontend/vercel.json acts as a redundant safety net. Both are safe (filesystem checks run before rewrites, so static assets under /static/* are unaffected).
Consider adding a cache-control header for /index.html to no-store to avoid stale SPA shells after deploy (nice-to-have).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed leads via API + contact form during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deep-link routing works on preview (CRA dev server historyApiFallback). The Vercel-side fix cannot be verified from here; user must push to GitHub and redeploy for actual Vercel validation. Backend + frontend regression is green.
rca of the issue: Original 404 on Vercel refresh for /personas /empresas /nosotros /contacto was caused by absence of SPA fallback rewrite on Vercel static hosting. Fix: added { source: '/(.*)', destination: '/index.html' } in vercel.json. Vercel rewrites execute after filesystem checks so static assets remain served directly; SPA routes now return index.html and react-router resolves the deep link client-side.
